findings.title: Editor drafts/claim targets are not bound to vehicle/warranty scope
findings.mechanism: Local draft/formOpen/claimFor/claimDraft state survives header vehicle changes. Coverage submit uses current vehicleId, whereas claim submit uses retained claimFor with no current-vehicle check. Cancel claim retains claimDraft; reopening a different warranty reuses it. Independent editor support deliberately preserves children.

repro.steps: A: enter a synthetic coverage draft, switch header to B: submit binds that draft to B. Open claim for A1, cancel, open A2: prior claim text/status/amount remains. Open claim A1 then switch vehicle B: target stays A1. No action executed.

findings.fix: Bind drafts and targets to stable vehicle/warranty IDs; visibly retain-and-block or explicitly discard with existing confirmation; validate scope at submit and protect late success callbacks from closing newer edits.

findings.title: Three warranty writes omit existing client live-mode guard

evidence.source: export async function request<T>(path: string, options: ApiRequestOptions = {}): Promise<T> {

findings.mechanism: All three request options omit requiresLiveMode. request defaults it false; assertOperationalWriteAllowed returns before checking historical/offline mode when false. PageContainer only displays its mode badge; page has no action gate. This proves this guard omission, not successful writes, permissions or an offline replay queue.

repro.steps: Trace POST/DELETE options to request false default and operationalMode:71 early return. Future separately authorized synthetic as_of-mode test should reject locally; no mode/request changed here.

findings.fix: Use existing requiresLiveMode:true and operational-mode disabled explanations for create/delete/claim; preserve fail-fast feedback, no replay queue.

findings.title: Mobile table allow-lists remove fields and Claim/Remove actions
findings.mechanism: All tables supply mobileColumns without mobilePresentation, expansion, detail links or alternative actions. DataTable marks excluded cells hidden md:table-cell; complete-details adapter is conditional on mobilePresentation. Excluded: readiness detail; warranty floor/deductible/actions; claim amount/evidence note. Column layout preferences do not override the mobile exclusion class.

repro.steps: Below declared md=768px inspect mobile allow-list versus columns: Claim and Remove actions are excluded, as are the listed fields. Source CSS path confirmed; viewport/browser behavior NOTRUN.

findings.fix: Adopt existing typed DataTable.mobilePresentation with all details and reachable actions, or preserve complete fields/actions in explicit contained scroll. Keep IDs, filters, preferences, export scope and order.

findings.title: Unknown battery retention hides the warranty-floor subsection
findings.mechanism: Entire battery retention Card is conditional on non-null retention, even for recorded battery warranty with known floor. Unknown facts remove the section instead of explicit unknown content.

repro.steps: Trace battery warranty with capacity_floor_pct=70 and capacity_retention_pct=null: section condition selects null.

findings.fix: Keep relevant battery subsection shell and explicit unknown retention/headroom; non-battery not-applicable metadata may remain conditional.

findings.title: Missing/invalid coverage start becomes the current instant
findings.mechanism: fromDateInput returns current ISO time for empty/invalid input; controlled draft stores it and renders a valid current date. Missing business fact bypasses empty required-field validation.

repro.steps: Trace Coverage start onChange with empty string: fromDateInput selects now, toDateInput renders nonempty current date. No native control exercised.

findings.fix: Preserve empty/invalid input and block submission through existing validation; retain valid wire date semantics, never fabricate today.

findings.title: No readiness returned is described as no coverage recorded
findings.mechanism: allChecks flattens readiness??[]; empty checks can coexist with recorded coverages. Empty message says no coverage recorded regardless of that distinction.

repro.steps: Trace one valid coverage with readiness=null or []: checklist says no coverage while burn-down/register shows it.

findings.fix: Distinguish no coverage from unavailable/not-evaluated readiness; preserve shell and truthful next step.

findings.title: Readiness keys rely on nonunique editable warranty labels
findings.mechanism: Flattened checks retain warrantyLabel but not warranty ID; key label-code collides for distinct warranties with identical labels and the same check code. Native reconciliation consequence not observed.

repro.steps: Two different warranty IDs with label Shield and code recorded produce the same Shield-recorded key; frontend has no label uniqueness declaration.

findings.fix: Carry warranty.id and key checks by ID+code, keeping human labels only for display.

findings.title: Known severity/kind/binding labels bypass i18n at five sites
findings.mechanism: Raw machine enums appear in severity badge, both kind displays, binding badge and kind options. These are known UI labels, not user/provider free text.

repro.steps: Trace non-English locale with battery/critical/distance: five sites emit raw tokens while surrounding text translates.

findings.fix: Reuse canonical enum mappings; parent owns only genuinely missing catalog labels; preserve wire values and unknown future-token fallback.

findings.title: Claim ledger omits existing translated status labels

evidence.source: export function VerdictBadge({ value, label, dot = true }: VerdictBadgeProps) {

findings.mechanism: Form translates all five claim statuses. Ledger supplies only VerdictBadge.value; draft/submitted/approved/denied/closed are absent from its known map, so fallback is untranslated. Neutral tone is not counted as an error or verified approval.

repro.steps: Trace submitted in non-English locale: form maps through t, ledger outputs submitted.

findings.fix: Pass existing CLAIM_STATUS_LABELS[row.status](t) through label prop; do not remigrate completed41-verdict map or imply provider verification.

findings.title: Evidence quality badge emits raw known status
findings.mechanism: Closed sufficient/limited/insufficient enum is rendered directly despite existing canonical ownership.verdict translations.

repro.steps: Trace sufficient with non-English locale: badge child remains raw token.

findings.fix: Reuse existing VerdictBadge/quality labels once at EvidencePanel owner; preserve tones, reasons, source states and evidence arrays.

findings.title: Delete confirmation Cancel uses English shared default

evidence.source: <Button type="button" variant="secondary" wrapLabel className="min-h-11 md:min-h-10" onClick={onCancel} disabled={loading}>

findings.mechanism: Page omits cancelLabel; useConfirm forwards undefined; ConfirmDialog defaults to literal Cancel and renders it directly. Mandatory danger confirmation remains intact.

repro.steps: Trace handleRemove options in non-English locale to default Cancel.

findings.fix: Localize undefined shared default with common.cancel, or supply translated caller cancelLabel; preserve explicit overrides, danger, typed and silence policies.

findings.title: Eight date displays ignore saved locale
findings.mechanism: Page formatDateTime calls omit options. dateFormat intlLocale(undefined) returns undefined and uses browser locale, unlike units/money consuming saved settings.locale. No timezone/12h setting claim.

repro.steps: Trace saved locale fr-FR with browser en-US: eight page date outputs use browser formatting while amount/distance use saved locale.

findings.fix: Pass existing effective locale/preference options to shared date formatter; preserve instants and independent business dates, no new formatter.
